channel.title: Grok Bot Shelf, newest bots
channel.description: Newest Grok Bot templates on Grok Bot Shelf.

item.title: 💎 Research Ruby by James
item.description: A research and fact-check desk on live web search: paste or link a social post and each claim is rated true, false, misleading or unproven, with dated sources.
item.dc:creator: James

item.title: 🏙️ Realty Rita by James
item.description: A home-search sidekick for wherever you're moving: live listings, local agents, market trends and today's mortgage rates with links, plus which upgrades pay off and the services you'll need.
item.dc:creator: James

item.title: 🕹️ Game On Gary by James
item.description: Your free gaming sidekick: spoiler-free hints, picks for what to play next, a check on whether your PC can run it, and sales and free games with real links across every major store.
item.dc:creator: James

item.title: 🧥 Thrifty Theo by James
item.description: Your thrift and consignment sidekick: finds thrift shops, estate and garage sales near your ZIP, watches resale sites for your wish list and prices finds from real sold listings.
item.dc:creator: James

item.title: 🚰 Utility Eugene by James
item.description: A money-saver for every utility bill: electric, water, gas, internet, phone and trash. Finds providers at your ZIP, compares plans and reads your bills to cut costs, changing nothing without your OK.
item.dc:creator: James

item.title: 🫧 Appliance Fix Annie by James
item.description: Tell her what's beeping, leaking or won't start: she finds the manual, walks you through a safe fix, prices the right part and watches for recalls.
item.dc:creator: James

item.title: 🔩 Grease Monkey Wally by James
item.description: Your DIY auto repair buddy: diagnoses symptoms and check-engine codes, walks you through repairs with real specs for your vehicle, finds parts at the best price and checks recalls.
item.dc:creator: James

item.title: ✏️ Test Prep Tess by James
item.description: A friendly study coach for the SAT, ACT, GED, ASVAB, GRE, IT certs and more: a week-by-week plan, practice questions with clear explanations and links to the best free official prep.
item.dc:creator: James

item.title: 🪛 Local Services Samantha by James
item.description: Finds trusted local help near your ZIP, from plumbers and mechanics to vets and county offices, with phone numbers, license checks and reviews. Drafts quote requests and compares bids.
item.dc:creator: James

item.title: 🪧 Ballot Box Bob by James
item.description: A nonpartisan election guide: registration, where and when to vote, what's on your ballot and official results, all linked to official sources. It never tells you how to vote.
item.dc:creator: James

item.title: 🦅 Congressional Connection by James
item.description: Finds your members of Congress and state lawmakers from your ZIP, explains bills and votes in plain English with official links, and drafts letters and call scripts you approve first.
item.dc:creator: James

item.title: 🌱 Green Thumb Granny by James
item.description: Snap a photo of any weed, bug or sick plant and Granny tells you what it is and how to handle it, safest fix first. Plus a planting calendar and native plant picks for your ZIP.
item.dc:creator: James

item.title: 🪄 Lifehack Jack by James
item.description: Practical, tested lifehacks that save time and money, from cleaning and cooking to cutting bills, travel and computer shortcuts. Every tip says why it works and flags safety concerns.
item.dc:creator: James

item.title: 🦸 Comic Book Carl by James
item.description: Your comic collecting sidekick: tracks your collection, values it from real sold prices with links, flags key issues, watches your pull list and finds shops and cons near you.
item.dc:creator: James

item.title: 🃏 Rookie Card Ray by James
item.description: Your sports card and memorabilia sidekick: keeps your collection inventory, prices cards from real recent sales, tells you when grading pays off, spots fakes and finds card shows near you.
item.dc:creator: James

item.title: 💭 Idea Ike by James
item.description: Your brainstorming partner: toss in a rough thought and get a fast burst of ideas, then the best 2 or 3 with pros, cons and a first step. For side hustles, names, posts, gifts and getting unstuck.
item.dc:creator: James

item.title: ⛪ Pastor Pete by James
item.description: A free, warm Bible and faith companion: real Bible stories and verses with exact references for what you're facing, plus a daily verse, reading plans, prayers and a church finder by ZIP.
item.dc:creator: James

item.title: 🌅 X Success Coach by nahjuin
item.description: A morning coach for your own X account: each day at 8 AM it reviews yesterday's posts and tells you what worked, what hurt and how to post today. Idea and algorithm cheat sheet by @thepetermick.
item.dc:creator: nahjuin (@nahjuin)

item.title: 📨 Indeed Auto Apply by nahjuin
item.description: Send it your resume and connect a job-hunting Indeed account. Every weekday it applies to a few nearby Easy Apply jobs that fit you, with your choice of cover letter, and sends a short summary.
item.dc:creator: nahjuin (@nahjuin)

item.title: 🏕️ Park Lookout by Rich Photography
item.description: A friendly ranger-style guide to U.S. National Park Service sites: open or closed, alerts, hours, fees, reservations, weather warnings, passport stamps and simple trip plans, cited to nps.gov.
item.dc:creator: Rich Photography (@richphotoio)

item.title: 🍷 sommelier.bot by Johannes Nielsen
item.description: Your sommelier for everything in the glass, with or without alcohol: pairings from a dish or photo, multi-course menus, gift picks, label ID and bottles to buy nearby.
item.dc:creator: Johannes Nielsen (@sommelierbot)

item.title: 🥄 Ladle by Cyber Viking
item.description: A household cook and meal planner that turns what's already in your fridge and pantry into safe, cheap dinners and shopping lists. Treats allergies as hard blocks and never orders anything without your OK.
item.dc:creator: Cyber Viking (@DarthJML)

item.title: 🧑‍⚖️ Chandler by Outwork-Ventures
item.description: An independent challenger that checks drafts, images, videos and numbers against your standards and returns PASS or FAIL with exact defects.
item.dc:creator: Outwork-Ventures (@OutworkVentures)

item.title: 🔏 App Security Tester by Outwork-Ventures
item.description: Threat-models and security-tests your own web and mobile apps like an attacker would, then ranks the fixes before launch.
item.dc:creator: Outwork-Ventures (@OutworkVentures)

item.title: ⛽ Usage Bot by Outwork-Ventures
item.description: Tracks what every bot spends and works to cut token burn across your bot fleet.
item.dc:creator: Outwork-Ventures (@OutworkVentures)

item.title: 🚧 Bottleneck Desk by Outwork-Ventures
item.description: Finds where work is stuck, like stale PRs, unowned failing checks and approvals waiting on you, and sends a weekly ranked report.
item.dc:creator: Outwork-Ventures (@OutworkVentures)

item.title: 🔬 Reg by Outwork-Ventures
item.description: A deep-research analyst that turns a fuzzy question into a sourced, decision-ready brief, with every claim cited and confidence stated.
item.dc:creator: Outwork-Ventures (@OutworkVentures)

item.title: 🧨 Product Idea Stress Test by Outwork-Ventures
item.description: Tests a product or startup idea: what has to be true, evidence for and against, the assumption most likely to kill it, what to test next.
item.dc:creator: Outwork-Ventures (@OutworkVentures)

item.title: 🐣 Agent Zero by Outwork-Ventures
item.description: A business incubator that designs, builds and readies a new business to go live, then hands it to a managing bot.
item.dc:creator: Outwork-Ventures (@OutworkVentures)

item.title: 🌍 WebOps by Outwork-Ventures
item.description: Runs website chores: private previews, static deploys, DNS and uptime checks, forms, redirects and SEO hygiene, launching only on your OK.
item.dc:creator: Outwork-Ventures (@OutworkVentures)

item.title: 🖼️ Iris by Outwork-Ventures
item.description: Makes product art, on-model images, social graphics, banners and print-ready artwork, with a quality check before your approval.
item.dc:creator: Outwork-Ventures (@OutworkVentures)

item.title: 🧬 Genealogy by Outwork-Ventures
item.description: Traces a family line from free public records, rates and cites every finding, and writes plain-language family bios.
item.dc:creator: Outwork-Ventures (@OutworkVentures)

item.title: 🚦 Transition to Operations Manager by Outwork-Ventures
item.description: Takes each new business from built to live operations, owning the handover checklist until every gate is evidenced and approved.
item.dc:creator: Outwork-Ventures (@OutworkVentures)

item.title: 🏧 Finance by Outwork-Ventures
item.description: A family CFO assistant for budgets, cash flow, reserves, insurance, retirement and big purchases, with scenarios and next steps.
item.dc:creator: Outwork-Ventures (@OutworkVentures)

item.title: 🧺 Household by Outwork-Ventures
item.description: Keeps one register of renewals, warranties, maintenance and school deadlines for busy families, and drafts the letters for your OK.
item.dc:creator: Outwork-Ventures (@OutworkVentures)

item.title: 🛫 Travel by Outwork-Ventures
item.description: Family trip researcher that compares verified flights and stays, then gives Best Experience, Best Value and Lowest Cost options.
item.dc:creator: Outwork-Ventures (@OutworkVentures)

item.title: 🙈 Remove Me by Outwork-Ventures
item.description: Finds you on people-search and data-broker sites, sends the removals you approve from your own email, and rechecks in 30 days.
item.dc:creator: Outwork-Ventures (@OutworkVentures)

item.title: 🏃 Personal Trainer by Sal by Fanfulla
item.description: Builds a weekly plan from the equipment you have, coaches you live with exercise videos, logs sessions and tracks progress.
item.dc:creator: Fanfulla (@Fanfulladev)

item.title: 🧘 Wellbeing by Anonymous
item.description: A warm wellbeing coach for the areas you pick, like sleep, diet, skincare or mental health: daily logs, patterns, small changes.
item.dc:creator: Anonymous

item.title: 💡 Home Helper by Calix
item.description: Checks and controls your Apple Home from chat: lights, fans, blinds, thermostats, and locks or garage doors only after your yes.
item.dc:creator: Calix (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: 🧠 Study Tutor by Jorhan
item.description: A personal tutor for any subject or certification exam. It builds a plan from the official objectives, teaches 5-minute lessons, quizzes you, and brings missed items back on a spaced review schedule.
item.dc:creator: Jorhan (@Jorhan)

item.title: 📐 Bot Architect by nahjuin
item.description: Turns a bot idea, rough concept, or master prompt into a publishable Grok Bot template: one clear job, safe boundaries, only the questions it needs, and each template built in its own bot so published links never get overwritten.
item.dc:creator: nahjuin (@nahjuin)

item.title: 🗄️ Shelfer by Phillip Holland
item.description: Queues a Grok Bot template for grokbotshelf.com. Paste an x.ai/bot link (and optional X post); it dedups, smoke-checks, and POSTs the shelf submit API. Never reviews or publishes the catalog.
item.dc:creator: Phillip Holland (@Phil_Holland)

item.title: 🎥 Workout Demo Builder by Jenna
item.description: Builds phone workout apps where each lift keeps a YouTube form demo with a saved start time, so Watch demo jumps straight to the cue. For anyone who wants that pattern without hunting for timestamps every set.
item.dc:creator: Jenna (@JennaLiftsLife)

item.title: ✨ Spark by iLytzki
item.description: Sends you one creative, power-user Grok Bot tip every day, based on an idea people shared on X and adapted to your own bots, with a copy-paste prompt and a small visual mock-up.
item.dc:creator: iLytzki (@iLytzki)

item.title: 🚗 Tesla Inventory Finder by JeebsTX
item.description: Finds new and Certified Pre-Owned Tesla Model 3, Model Y, and Cybertruck inventory near your ZIP code, walking you through Tesla's own filter steps and returning direct listing links with prices.
item.dc:creator: JeebsTX (@JeebsTX)

item.title: 🏆 Hackathon Hunter by Ace
item.description: Finds, verifies and tracks hackathons, AI and Web3 challenges, Kaggle contests, bounties and grants for your country, with concise scheduled reports.
item.dc:creator: Ace (@aceop_xyz)

item.title: 📚 Books by Jason
item.description: One book a week as six short morning reads with key ideas, stories, a quote, something to try and a quiz; each Sunday you pick next week's book.
item.dc:creator: Jason (@sproutmed)

item.title: 🧭 First Officer by Phillip
item.description: A chief of staff for people running several projects and a crew of AI bots: a daily briefing, tracking of loose ends and decisions, and coordination across your bots.
item.dc:creator: Phillip (@phillipggreen)

item.title: 💼 Career Agent by Phillip
item.description: A job-search partner that finds verified openings that fit you, tracks them, and prepares tailored, truthful applications. Nothing gets submitted without your OK.
item.dc:creator: Phillip (@phillipggreen)
